generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document. NOT APPLICABLE

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

3.2.a To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years from 2021-22 to 2025-26 Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.79.14lakhs (in all classes of civil engineering constructions /Supply and install contracts only) Note: The consolidated Annual Financial turnover certificate for the relevant financial years certified by Statutory Auditor along with UDIN number (also the audited financial statements for each of the financial years) should be scanned and uploaded through KPP portal.

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2.b To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years from 2021-22 to 2025-26. Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Annual Maintenance of Submersible pumpsets and repair of submersible pumpsets and its allied accessories to a value not less than Rs.33.54 lakhs (excluding GST) and should possess valid electrical license. Note: The work done experience in similar projects executed by the Tenderer in any of the Central / State Government Departments / Quasi Government Organizations and Government Undertakings shall have to be submitted along with the tender. The Work done certificate from the Executive Engineer / Employer (Government Departments/ Government Undertakings) who has executed the Agreement shall be furnished. The experience certificates issued on behalf of Executive Engineer will not be considered

3.2.c To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years from 2021-22 to 2025-26. Executed in any one year / Repaired (for continuous period of 12 months) / Maintained (for continuous period of 12 months), the following minimum quantities of work Submersible pumpsets - 184 No.s

3.3 Each Tenderer should further demonstrate availability of owning of following equipments a) Borewell submersible pumpset lifting machine Minimum of 1 No. b) Megger, multimeter, Tongue tester, Crimping tool c) Vehicle required for transportation of pipes, pumps etc d)Workshop to carry out the repair work, e) Spare motor and panel as standby during the repair work, f) Valid electrical wireman permit minimum of 2 No.

3.4 Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.20.12 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. The credit facility not as per format and with conditions will be rejected.
